transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Um... I'm here because... well, people keep telling me they can't follow what I'm trying to explain. At work. Like, in my artist statements, or my notes for clients... even just when I talk in meetings. I guess they think I keep jumping around too much. From, like, the textures of a piece, to the budgets, and then to... I don't know, secret meanings. They just say they can't understand me lately. So... I guess that's why I came in.
Have you been feeling unusually energetic, irritable, or like you need much less sleep than usual lately?

Um... I suppose there are stretches where I feel... I don't know, just lit up. Like I'm almost unstoppable and every idea I have is brilliant. But... then if a collaborator makes even a small comment, I... I guess I can snap at them. In a way that's... probably bigger than the situation actually warrants. So... yeah, maybe.

Have you ever had experiences where you heard or saw things that others couldn't, or felt convinced of things that others told you weren't true, even when you weren't feeling that 'lit up' or energetic?

Um... yeah, I guess so. There was a time... maybe a month or so, where things were quieter. I was sleeping okay, not feeling so... intense. But I was still... I kept hearing these comments. Like, coming from behind the shelves in my studio. And I kept seeing things in the materials... like warnings, just in the way the clay or the paint was sitting. It went on for a few weeks, even though I wasn't feeling that high energy.

Looking back at that time when you were hearing those comments and seeing warnings, were you experiencing a significant change in your mood, like feeling extremely depressed or hopeless, during those specific few weeks?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I felt... hopeless, or anything like that. I was just... going about my day, trying to work. My mood was mostly just... fine, I guess.
How long have you been experiencing these periods of hearing voices or feeling that your art contains secret warnings, looking back to when they first started?

Um... I guess... if I really think about when it started... the things in the materials, and the voices... maybe the smells too... it's been going on for... I don't know, roughly eleven months. Something like that.

Looking at those eleven months, would you say that the times when you were feeling 'lit up' or irritable happened more often than not, or were those periods of high energy relatively short compared to the time you spent feeling more like your usual self?

Um... I guess... if I look at the whole time... the whole eleven months... 

The times when I felt... really energized, or irritable, and just... doing so much... they definitely took up more of the year. It goes up and down, but... yeah, the high energy parts were... they were around more often than the calm parts.
During those eleven months, have there been any periods of at least two weeks where you felt profoundly sad, lost interest in all your usual activities, or felt completely empty inside?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I haven't really felt sad like that. Or empty. Just... mostly the other way, I guess. I still did my art.
Are you currently convinced that these 'warnings' in your art or the comments you hear are actually true, even when you are around other people who tell you they don't see or hear anything?

I mean... yes. I do. It's... when I see the stains on the canvas, or the way a seam is stitched, or even just... phrases in emails from the galleries... it feels like they're meant for me. Like they're instructions. Or warnings. And... even if someone tries to explain it away as just a coincidence or something ordinary, I... it's really hard to let go of what I know it means.

Looking back over the entire last year, have you ever experienced a stretch of at least two weeks where you felt so down, hopeless, or lacked interest in your art that it was a significant change from your usual self?
No... I just said that. I haven't felt sad or... hopeless. Not for two weeks, not really at all. It's just been the other stuff.
During those eleven months, did the periods where you felt 'lit up' and energetic last for the majority of the time, or were they shorter episodes that occurred occasionally?

Um... the majority, I guess. The... energized parts, feeling kind of irritable and working all the time... that took up more of the year than the calmer stretches. Even with it going up and down sometimes... it was mostly that.

Are there any periods of time during these eleven months where you felt completely like your usual self, without the high energy or irritability, but you were still hearing the voices or seeing those warnings?

Yeah... I think there was. Maybe a month where things were... quieter. I was actually sleeping normally, and I didn't feel so... unstoppable, I guess. 

But... the other stuff didn't stop. I still heard the comments coming from behind the shelves. And... I was still seeing those warnings in my studio materials for several weeks, even when my energy was normal.

During that month when your energy was normal and you weren't feeling 'lit up,' were you still feeling convinced that those warnings and messages were definitely real, even though you weren't experiencing any mood changes at that time?

Yeah... like I just said. Even during that quieter month, when I was actually sleeping and not feeling so unstoppable... I still heard the comments from behind the shelves. And I was still finding those hidden warnings in my studio materials for weeks. So... yeah. They were real.

When you are speaking to others, do you feel that your thoughts themselves become scrambled or that you lose your train of thought, or is it mostly that people don't understand the specific messages or warnings you are trying to share with them?

I guess... maybe they get scrambled. People just keep telling me they can't follow what I'm saying. That's actually sort of why I came in. 

They said my artist statements and client notes were jumping around too much. Even when I speak in meetings... I'll go from talking about textures to budgets, and then to the secret meanings. And... they just say they don't understand what I'm trying to explain.

When you are speaking to others, do you feel like your thoughts are racing so fast that you can't keep up with them, or do you feel like your thoughts are just disconnected and don't make sense to you either?

I don't know if they're disconnected... but they definitely go fast. Sometimes too fast. 

Like... I'll be thinking about an image, and then a title for it, and then the wording for a grant, and then... colors, and things people said. It all just... stacks up on top of each other. Before I can even finish thinking about the first thing. So... yeah, I guess they race.
During that month when your energy was normal and you felt like your usual self, did you still find that your thoughts were racing or that your speech was hard for others to follow?
I don't think so. No. When I felt normal, I was just... normal. My thoughts weren't going fast then. People could understand me fine.
